verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a 'Feeds' guide as its own ingestion feature, but the pack gives only the title, with no detail on which third-party cloud apps or partner feeds it supports. Warehouse Sync documents ingestion from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks, which shows inbound data beyond instrumented apps, but it pulls from the customer's own warehouse rather than third-party apps. Missing for 10: substantive Feeds documentation, a list of supported third-party cloud-app/feed input partners, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps

citations.quote: Warehouse Sync ingests data from your own warehouse into mParticle
